H9QO6SNJVr0.speaker_note: continues his Ramadan surah-summary series and tells stories of his own teachers
H9QO6SNJVr0.title: Surah Summaries: Al-Shams & Al-Layl
H9QO6SNJVr0.one_line: Ash-Shams makes tazkiyah, taming the self, the key to success; Al-Layl defines taqwa as the shared minimum of giving, piety and belief.
H9QO6SNJVr0.summary: Two surahs, two tools of faith. Ash-Shams opens with eleven consecutive oaths, the longest run in the Quran, which he reads as Allah seizing our attention for two statements: whoever purifies the soul succeeds, whoever buries it fails. Purification is one of the core tasks of every messenger. Our instincts of ego, envy, greed and domination are what every creature survives on, but only humans are asked to change them, and tazkiyah means taming that strength, not erasing it into weakness. Thamud's slaughter of the she-camel shows how arrogance in one heart grows into bloodshed: violence is a symptom of an inner disease. He laments that Muslims have no methods or metrics for this and then wonder why they cannot work together, and shares how a teacher made him serve a man he disliked, along with his yearly challenge to break the fast on three dates while the family eats. Al-Layl affirms that human diversity is Allah's design, then names the common baseline, taqwa: giving of anything you have, guarding yourself, and affirming the best belief. That path is eased into ease, while stinginess and self-sufficiency lead into hardship, much as a child who skips studying pays later. Giving tastes sweeter than receiving, and the pious give purely for their Lord's face.

outline.heading: Opening
Ash-Shams: a theme in the middle framed by eleven oaths
outline.gist: The surah has an introduction of oaths, two central verses, and a closing example.

outline.heading: Eleven oaths by what we cannot control
outline.gist: Sun, moon, day, night, sky, earth and the soul: the longest sequence of oaths in the Quran, though Allah needs no oath to be believed.

outline.heading: The oaths seize attention for the central statement
outline.gist: Like someone grabbing your arm before speaking, the oaths signal that what follows must not be missed: success belongs to whoever purifies the soul.

outline.heading: Failure belongs to whoever buries the soul in its whims
outline.gist: Those who let the self sink into instincts and desires are disappointed in this life and the next.

outline.heading: Purification among the tasks of the messengers
outline.gist: Prophets recite Allah's signs, purify people, and teach the Book and the wisdom to practise it; purifying sits between knowing and doing.

outline.heading: Tazkiyah is Islam 101: the diseases we carry
outline.gist: After knowing Allah comes knowing yourself: vanity, arrogance, envy, showing off, indifference, hatred, laziness and greed are instincts all creatures share.

outline.heading: Only humans are asked to change their instincts
outline.gist: Animals have no reason to change; prophets were sent so humans would recognize the self-centred force inside and tame it.

outline.heading: Tame the strength, do not kill it
outline.gist: Purification does not make people weak; you keep the inner power but control it and use it for good.

outline.heading: How the Prophet purified his companions
outline.gist: He taught them to watch their urges and motives, turning them into selfless people who took nothing of the world with them.

outline.heading: Thamud: arrogance and oppression, then the she-camel slaughtered
outline.gist: Arrogance plus a drive to oppress produced transgression; the most wicked of them killed the camel and they were destroyed.

outline.heading: Bloodshed is the symptom, the heart is the cause
outline.gist: Every war, harm or oppression traces back to an unpurified self that can no longer tell right from wrong.

outline.heading: Why Muslims cannot get along
outline.gist: We do not train ourselves or our children in tazkiyah, then wonder why small communities are full of bickering and nothing gets done.

outline.heading: No methods, no metrics; the ego must be trained, not erased
outline.gist: We merely mention purification and move on; yet without ego no one survives, so it must be controlled and taught to function properly.

outline.heading: His teacher's method: serve the man you dislike
outline.gist: As a teenager he was made to fetch shoes and water for someone he resented before he could resume his Quran lessons; it was agonizing and then liberating.

outline.heading: The iftar challenge: three dates while the family eats
outline.gist: He challenges people to break the fast with a few dates and water, watch the family eat and return to cold leftovers, to change why they fast and to take control of the self.

outline.heading: Al-Layl: oaths by night, day, male and female; your strivings differ
outline.gist: The surah of taqwa, the last tool of this group, swears by pairs and states that people's paths in life are diverse.

outline.heading: Diversity is Allah's design and beauty
outline.gist: Differences in how we look, think and live are not a problem; Islam is not trying to make everyone the same.

outline.heading: Taqwa as the shared baseline
outline.gist: There must be a minimum of behaviour everyone shares across cultures, as Eid and prayer show unity within diverse customs.

outline.heading: Where right and wrong are drawn: three things
outline.gist: Many ways of life are fine, but three qualities separate right from wrong: one of belief, one of behaviour, and one joining them.

outline.heading: Giving comes first; eased toward ultimate ease
outline.gist: Giving of time, empathy, expertise or wealth, guarding oneself, and affirming the best belief lead to the easiest path.

outline.heading: The self wants it now
outline.gist: Like his eight-month-old, the self demands immediate gratification; cute in a baby, a problem in an adult.

outline.heading: Effort now for ease later: a parent's 'study'
outline.gist: Allah's prohibitions are like a parent's instruction to study: unpleasant now, they spare us misery and emptiness even in this life.

outline.heading: The stingy and self-sufficient are eased toward hardship
outline.gist: Those who withhold, feel no need for people or God, and deny the truth walk a path of difficulty without realizing it yet.

outline.heading: The neglected child analogy
outline.gist: A parent who lets children skip vegetables and school to keep them happy is neglectful; Allah's commands are for our own interest.

outline.heading: Those without Allah don't know what they are missing
outline.gist: Only someone who never tasted love of Allah thinks a faithless life is happier.

outline.heading: Giving tastes better than receiving
outline.gist: Try the sweetness of helping others and it becomes addictive; taqwa is the bare minimum joining belief and behaviour.

outline.heading: Guidance is upon Allah: 'does this displease Him?'
outline.gist: Taqwa means asking before acting whether it displeases Allah; these tools come from Him, since guiding is His responsibility.

outline.heading: To Him belong the last and the first: why not obey now?
outline.gist: Everyone will obey in the Hereafter, so it makes no sense to misbehave now.

outline.heading: The blazing fire and the most pious who gives to purify himself
outline.gist: Only the most wretched who turn away enter it; the most pious give their wealth to purify themselves, repaying no one.

outline.heading: Seeking only the face of the Most High
outline.gist: Taqwa is a question of priorities: if Allah is at the top, that person will be satisfied on the Day of Judgment.

themes.label: Tazkiyah: purifying and training the self
themes.note: Success hinges on purifying the self, which means taming strong instincts rather than erasing them.

themes.label: Envy, anger and other diseases of the heart
themes.note: Vanity, envy, greed and hatred are natural instincts that humans alone are asked to change.

themes.label: Humility vs vanity and arrogance
themes.note: Thamud's arrogance in one heart grew into bloodshed; outward violence is a symptom.

themes.label: Community building, cooperation and the ummah
themes.note: Neglect of tazkiyah explains why Muslim communities bicker and achieve little.

themes.label: Tolerance, pluralism and dealing with difference
themes.note: Diversity of people and paths is Allah's design and a beauty, not a problem.

themes.label: Taqwa and God-consciousness
themes.note: Taqwa is the shared minimum of belief and behaviour: giving, guarding oneself, affirming the truth.

themes.label: Zakat, charity and giving
themes.note: Giving of any kind comes first and leads to ease; it is sweeter than receiving.

themes.label: The Hereafter: resurrection, judgment, paradise, hellfire
themes.note: Everyone obeys in the end, so obey now; the pious are saved from the blazing fire.

quran.point: The messenger recites the signs, purifies people and teaches the Book and wisdom

maxims: The beast inside needs to be tamed, not killed
You're just seeing the symptom; the cause is inside
Taqwa is the bare minimum
Giving tastes better than receiving

stories.point: Arrogance and the urge to oppress in one person's heart spiralled into bloodshed and destruction

stories.who: His teacher, when he was a teenager
stories.point: Made to serve a man he disliked, he felt the ego suffocate and then a new sense of strength and control
Breaking the fast on a few dates while watching others eat changes why you fast and trains the self

contemporary: Small Muslim communities in a city unable to work together because of constant bickering
takeaways: Make purifying the self a deliberate practice with methods and ways to measure progress
Teach children about the diseases of the heart and how to control them
Do something the ego resists, such as serving someone you dislike
Give of whatever you have, time, empathy or expertise, not only money
Before acting, ask whether it displeases Allah

40:2.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
40:2.en: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Knower

40:3.ar: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوۡبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلۡعِقَابِ ذِي ٱلطَّوۡلِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
40:3.en: The Forgiver of sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Stern in punishment, the Bountiful. There is no Allah save Him. Unto Him is the journeying

40:4.ar: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
40:4.en: None argue concerning the revelations of Allah save those who disbelieve, so let not their turn of fortune in the land deceive thee (O Muhammad)

40:5.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۖ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ أُمَّةِۭ بِرَسُولِهِمۡ لِيَأۡخُذُوهُۖ وَجَٰدَلُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّ فَأَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
40:5.en: The folk of Noah and the factions after them denied (their messengers) before these, and every nation purposed to seize their messenger and argued falsely, (thinking) thereby to refute the Truth. Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment

40:6.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
40:6.en: Thus was the word of thy Lord concerning those who disbelieve fulfilled: That they are owners of the Fire

40:7.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءࣲ رَّحۡمَةࣰ وَعِلۡمࣰ ا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
40:7.en: Those who bear the Throne, and all who are round about it, hymn the praises of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe (saying): Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell

40:8.ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
40:8.en: Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised them, with such of their fathers and their wives and their descendants as do right. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise

40:9.ar: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
40:9.en: And ward off from them ill-deeds; and he from whom Thou wardest off ill-deeds that day, him verily hast Thou taken into mercy. That is the supreme triumph

40:10.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُ مِن مَّقۡتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ إِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكۡفُرُونَ
40:10.en: Lo! (on that day) those who disbelieve are informed by proclamation: Verily Allah's abhorrence is more terrible than your abhorrence one of another, when ye were called unto the faith but did refuse

40:11.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَأَحۡيَيۡتَنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَٱعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلۡ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجࣲ مِّن سَبِيلࣲ‏
40:11.en: They say: Our Lord! Twice hast Thou made us die, and twice hast Thou made us live. Now we confess our sins. Is there any way to go out

40:12.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُۥ كَفَرۡتُمۡ وَإِن يُشۡرَكۡ بِهِۦ تُؤۡمِنُواْۚ فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ
40:12.en: (It is said unto them): This is (your plight) because, when Allah only was invoked, ye disbelieved, but when some partner was ascribed to Him ye were believing. But the command belongeth only to Allah, the Sublime, the Majestic

40:13.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقࣰ اۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
40:13.en: He it is Who showeth you His portents, and sendeth down for you provision from the sky. None payeth heed save him who turneth (unto Him) repentant

40:14.ar: فَٱدۡعُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
40:14.en: Therefor (O believers) pray unto Allah, making religion pure for Him (only), however much the disbelievers be averse

40:15.ar: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُلۡقِي ٱلرُّوحَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ
40:15.en: The Exalter of Ranks, the Lord of the Throne. He causeth the Spirit of His command upon whom He will of His slaves, that He may warn of the Day of Meeting

40:16.ar: يَوۡمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءࣱۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ
40:16.en: The day when they come forth, nothing of them being hidden from Allah. Whose is the Sovereignty this day? It is Allah's, the One, the Almighty

40:17.ar: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۚ لَا ظُلۡمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
40:17.en: This day is each soul requited that which it hath earned; no wrong (is done) this day. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning

40:18.ar: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلۡحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ حَمِيمࣲ وَلَا شَفِيعࣲ يُطَاعُ
40:18.en: Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard

40:19.ar: يَعۡلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
40:19.en: He knoweth the traitor of the eyes, and that which the bosoms hide

40:20.ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡضِي بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقۡضُونَ بِشَيۡءٍۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
40:20.en: Allah judgeth with truth, while those to whom they cry instead of Him judge not at all. Lo! Allah, He is the Hearer, the Seer

40:21.ar: ۞أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةࣰ وَءَاثَارࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقࣲ‏
40:21.en: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who disbelieved before them? They were mightier than these in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. Yet Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah

40:22.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِيࣱّ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
40:22.en: That was because their messengers kept bringing them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) but they disbelieved; so Allah seized them. Lo! He is Strong, severe in punishment

40:23.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
40:23.en: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant

40:24.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابࣱ‏
40:24.en: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer

40:25.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَبۡنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسۡتَحۡيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ‏
40:25.en: And when he brought them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women. But the plot of disbelievers is in naught but error

40:26.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُونِيٓ أَقۡتُلۡ مُوسَىٰ وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهُۥٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَن يُظۡهِرَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ
40:26.en: And Pharaoh said: Suffer me to kill Moses, and let him cry unto his Lord. Lo! I fear that he will alter your religion or that he will cause confusion in the land

40:27.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرࣲ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
40:27.en: Moses said: Lo! I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning

40:28.ar: وَقَالَ رَجُلࣱ مُّؤۡمِنࣱ مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقۡتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبࣰ ا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهُۥۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقࣰ ا يُصِبۡكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي يَعِدُكُمۡۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفࣱ كَذَّابࣱ‏
40:28.en: And a believing man of Pharaoh's family, who hid his faith, said: Would ye kill a man because he saith: My Lord is Allah, and hath brought you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is lying, then his lie is upon him; and if he is truthful, then some of that wherewith he threateneth you will strike you. Lo! Allah guideth not one who is a prodigal, a liar

40:29.ar: يَٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأۡسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَاۚ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمۡ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهۡدِيكُمۡ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
40:29.en: O my people! Yours is the kingdom to-day, ye being uppermost in the land. But who would save us from the wrath of Allah should it reach us? Pharaoh said: I do but show you what I think, and I do but guide you to wise policy

40:30.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
40:30.en: And he who believed said: O my people! Lo! I fear for you a fate like that of the factions (of old)

40:31.ar: مِثۡلَ دَأۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣲ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلۡمࣰ ا لِّلۡعِبَادِ
40:31.en: A plight like that of Noah's folk, and A'ad and Thamud, and those after them, and Allah willeth no injustice for (His) slaves

40:32.ar: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ
40:32.en: And, O my people! Lo! I fear for you a Day of Summoning

40:33.ar: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدۡبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمࣲۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادࣲ‏
40:33.en: A day when ye will turn to flee, having no preserver from Allah: and he whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

40:34.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبۡلُ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ رَسُولࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفࣱ مُّرۡتَابٌ
40:34.en: And verily Joseph brought you of old clear proofs, yet ye ceased not to be in doubt concerning what he brought you till, when he died, ye said: Allah will not send any messenger after him. Thus Allah deceiveth him who is a prodigal, a doubter

40:35.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمۡۖ كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلۡبِ مُتَكَبِّرࣲ جَبَّارࣲ‏
40:35.en: Those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without any warrant that hath come unto them, it is greatly hateful in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who believe. Thus doth Allah print on every arrogant, disdainful heart

40:36.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبۡنِ لِي صَرۡحࣰ ا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَبۡلُغُ ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبَ
40:36.en: And Pharaoh said: O Haman! Build for me a tower that haply I may reach the roads

40:37.ar: أَسۡبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبࣰ اۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابࣲ‏
40:37.en: The roads of the heavens, and may look upon the god of Moses, though verily I think him a liar. Thus was the evil that he did made fairseeming unto Pharaoh, and he was debarred from the (right) way. The plot of Pharaoh ended but in ruin

40:38.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهۡدِكُمۡ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
40:38.en: And he who believed said: O my people! Follow me. I will show you the way of right conduct

40:39.ar: يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَتَٰعࣱ وَإِنَّ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ ٱلۡقَرَارِ
40:39.en: O my people! Lo! this life of the world is but a passing comfort, and lo! the Hereafter, that is the enduring home

40:40.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةࣰ فَلَا يُجۡزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنࣱ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
40:40.en: Whoso doeth an ill-deed, he will be repaid the like thereof, while whoso doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, (all) such will enter the Garden, where they will be nourished without stint

40:41.ar: ۞وَيَٰقَوۡمِ مَا لِيٓ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
40:41.en: And, O my people! What aileth me that I call you unto deliverance when ye call me unto the Fire

40:42.ar: تَدۡعُونَنِي لِأَكۡفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِهِۦ عِلۡمࣱ وَأَنَا۠ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرِ
40:42.en: Ye call me to disbelieve in Allah and ascribe unto Him as partners that whereof I have no knowledge, while I call you unto the Mighty, the Forgiver

40:43.ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةࣱ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
40:43.en: Assuredly that whereunto ye call me hath no claim in the world or in the Hereafter, and our return will be unto Allah, and the prodigals will be owners of the Fire

40:44.ar: فَسَتَذۡكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمۡرِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
40:44.en: And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves

40:45.ar: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُواْۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
40:45.en: So Allah warded off from him the evils which they plotted, while a dreadful doom encompassed Pharaoh's folk

40:46.ar: ٱلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوࣰّ ا وَعَشِيࣰّ اۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡخِلُوٓاْ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
40:46.en: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening; and on the day when the Hour upriseth (it is said): Cause Pharaoh's folk to enter the most awful doom

40:47.ar: وَإِذۡ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعࣰ ا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ
40:47.en: And when they wrangle in the Fire, the weak say unto those who were proud: Lo! we were a following unto you; will ye therefor rid us of a portion of the Fire

40:48.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُلࣱّ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ حَكَمَ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡعِبَادِ
40:48.en: Those who were proud say: Lo! we are all (together) herein. Lo! Allah hath judged between (His) slaves

40:49.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ يُخَفِّفۡ عَنَّا يَوۡمࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
40:49.en: And those in the Fire say unto the guards of hell: Entreat your Lord that He relieve us of a day of the torment

40:50.ar: قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ تَكُ تَأۡتِيكُمۡ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰۚ قَالُواْ فَٱدۡعُواْۗ وَمَا دُعَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٍ
40:50.en: They say: Came not your messengers unto you with clear proofs? They say: Yea, verily. They say: Then do ye pray, although the prayer of disbelievers is in vain

40:51.ar: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَيَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡأَشۡهَٰدُ
40:51.en: Lo! We verily do help Our messengers, and those who believe, in the life of the world and on the day when the witnesses arise

40:52.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
40:52.en: The day when their excuse availeth not the evil-doers, and theirs is the curse, and theirs the ill abode

40:53.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ
40:53.en: And We verily gave Moses the guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture

40:54.en: A guide and a reminder for men of understanding

40:55.ar: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقࣱّ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ
40:55.en: Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness of thy sin, and hymn the praise of thy Lord at fall of night and in the early hours

40:56.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمۡ إِن فِي صُدُورِهِمۡ إِلَّا كِبۡرࣱ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِۚ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
40:56.en: Lo! those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without a warrant having come unto them, there is naught else in their breasts save pride which they will never attain. So take thou refuge in Allah. Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer

40:57.ar: لَخَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
40:57.en: Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind; but most of mankind know not

40:58.ar: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَلَا ٱلۡمُسِيٓءُۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
40:58.en: And the blind man and the seer are not equal, neither are those who believe and do good works (equal with) the evil-doer. Little do ye reflect

40:59.ar: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةࣱ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
40:59.en: Lo! the Hour is surely coming, there is no doubt thereof; yet most of mankind believe not

40:60.ar: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدۡعُونِيٓ أَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدۡخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
40:60.en: And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced

40:61.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
40:61.en: Allah it is Who hath appointed for you night that ye may rest therein, and day for seeing. Lo! Allah is a Lord of bounty for mankind, yet most of mankind give not thanks

40:62.ar: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ
40:62.en: Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye perverted

40:65.ar: هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدۡعُوهُ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَۗ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
40:65.en: He is the Living One. There is no Allah save Him. So pray unto Him, making religion pure for Him (only). Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

40:69.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصۡرَفُونَ
40:69.en: Hast thou not seen those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah, how they are turned away

40:70.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَاۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
40:70.en: Those who deny the Scripture and that wherewith We send Our messengers. But they will come to know

40:71.ar: إِذِ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسۡحَبُونَ
40:71.en: When carcans are about their necks and chains. They are dragged

40:72.ar: فِي ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي ٱلنَّارِ يُسۡجَرُونَ
40:72.en: Through boiling waters; then they are thrust into the Fire

40:75.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَمۡرَحُونَ
40:75.en: (And it is said unto them): This is because ye exulted in the earth without right, and because ye were petulant

40:82.ar: أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةࣰ وَءَاثَارࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
40:82.en: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those before them? They were more numerous than these, and mightier in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. But all that they used to earn availed them not

40:83.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُواْ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
40:83.en: And when their messengers brought them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) they exulted in the knowledge they (themselves) possessed. And that which they were wont to mock befell them

40:84.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحۡدَهُۥ وَكَفَرۡنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشۡرِكِينَ
40:84.en: Then, when they saw Our doom, they said: We believe in Allah only and reject (all) that we used to associate (with Him)

40:85.ar: فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمۡ إِيمَٰنُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَاۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِي عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
40:85.en: But their faith could not avail them when they saw Our doom. This is Allah's law which hath ever taken course for His bondmen. And then the disbelievers will be ruined

_5cGfBvgnnY.title: Surat Ghafir Summary
_5cGfBvgnnY.one_line: Ghafir opens the Ha-Mim cluster: keep calling to Allah even those who argue, balance mercy and warning, entrust the outcome to Him and make much dua.
_5cGfBvgnnY.summary: With the cluster from Al-Ahzab to Az-Zumar on submission complete, he opens the Ha-Mim surahs, which he reads as advice and warnings for those serving Allah and His message. Ghafir's lesson is to take the call to those who dispute Allah's signs, argue with them, and meanwhile build your relationship with Allah on entrusting the matter to Him and constant dua. The opening names, forgiver of sin and accepter of repentance yet severe in punishment, show the balance a caller must keep; tipping it either way has driven people from the deen in past centuries. The angels around the Throne pray for the believers, and disbelievers on the Day of Judgment loathe themselves for not listening, so no one may write a person off: keep calling because you never know who will respond. The believing man of Pharaoh's family shows the method: he could not hide his faith, argued with logic, admonition, emotion and history, then entrusted his affair to Allah. Tyrants always accuse reformers of corruption. Arrogance means reaching for a station Allah never gave you and ends in regret. Allah commands us to call on Him now, because dua in the Fire goes unanswered.

outline.gist: Do not be deceived by their movement through the land; earlier nations argued with falsehood to refute the truth and were seized.

outline.heading: The previous cluster, surah by surah
outline.gist: Al-Ahzab on obeying when commands are hard, Saba on a society submitting, Fatir on understanding Allah well, Ya-Sin on submission as true life, As-Saffat on accepting the unseen, Sad on returning to truth, Az-Zumar on sincerity.

outline.heading: The Ha-Mim cluster: advice and warnings while serving Allah
outline.gist: Having learned our mission, these surahs point out what to hold to and what to watch for in dawah work.

outline.heading: Ghafir's theme: call those who argue, and entrust the matter to Allah
outline.gist: Take the call to those who dispute, argue with them, and keep your relationship with Allah built on tafwid and much dua.

outline.heading: Keeping mercy and warning in balance
outline.gist: Letting one side outweigh the other has caused misunderstanding of Allah, people fleeing the deen and poor practice.

outline.heading: The angels bearing the Throne pray for the believers
outline.gist: They ask Allah, whose mercy and knowledge encompass everything, to forgive those who repent and admit them and their families to Paradise.

outline.heading: Disbelievers loathing themselves on the Day
outline.gist: They are bitterly regretful for not following, which is why we keep calling: you never know who will listen.

outline.heading: Raised in ranks, He sends the spirit to warn of the Day of Meeting
outline.gist: On that day nothing is hidden and the dominion belongs to Allah alone.

outline.heading: Every soul repaid, no injustice today
outline.gist: Allah is swift in account; he then restates how the surah opens with the angels' dua for the believers.

outline.heading: Never write anyone off
outline.gist: Since people will loathe themselves for not listening, keep calling whatever happens; we have no right to judge someone lost, only to do our part out of concern for them.

outline.heading: Pharaoh: let me kill Musa
outline.gist: Glorifying Allah leads to entrusting the matter to Him; Pharaoh fears Musa will change their religion or spread corruption.

outline.heading: Musa seeks refuge and the believing man speaks up
outline.gist: Would you kill a man for saying my Lord is Allah? If he lies it is on him, if he is truthful some of what he warns will strike you.

outline.heading: A man who could not keep silent
outline.gist: He has to say what he knows must be said: follow me, I will guide you to the right way.

outline.heading: I entrust my affair to Allah
outline.gist: He ends by telling them they will remember his words; disputing Allah's signs without authority is hateful to Allah and the believers.

outline.heading: Why do I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire?
outline.gist: Musa's story recurs often in the Quran, but only here do we meet this believing man.

outline.heading: Tyrants accuse reformers of corruption
outline.gist: Despots always paint those who bring reform as the source of chaos; Musa shows how to entrust our affairs to Allah and keep calling, and the believing man's hidden faith bursts onto his tongue.

outline.heading: His method: logic, admonition, emotion and history
outline.gist: He urges the audience to study these verses, including his reminder that Yusuf came to them before with clear proofs.

outline.heading: Allah protected him from their plots
outline.gist: We do not know whether he died, stayed or left with Musa; we only know he spoke the truth, called to his Lord and entrusted the matter to Allah.

outline.heading: The followers and the arrogant in the Fire
outline.gist: The weak ask those they followed to lift some of the punishment; the keepers of Hell tell them to call, but the call of disbelievers is lost.

outline.heading: Call on Me, I will respond
outline.gist: Allah opens communication now; those too proud to worship Him will enter Hell humiliated.

outline.heading: Be patient, Allah's promise is true
outline.gist: Glorify your Lord evening and morning; those who argue without authority have only arrogance in their chests, a greatness they will never reach.

outline.heading: The weak and the arrogant: no relief in the Fire
outline.gist: He retells the exchange in Arabic: the dua of disbelievers on that Day goes unanswered.

outline.heading: Dua now, or a dua that is never answered
outline.gist: Allah commands us to build a relationship with Him, to speak to Him, ask and seek forgiveness; we choose between calling Him in this life or in vain on the Day.

outline.heading: Arrogance: reaching for a station Allah never gave you
outline.gist: Those who argue have no proof or logic, only pride they will never attain, and they end in severe regret.

outline.heading: Creation of the heavens is greater than creation of people
outline.gist: Allah made the night for rest and the day for sight, yet most people do not give thanks.

outline.heading: Call on Him sincerely; the fate of those who argue
outline.gist: Those who deny the Book will be dragged in chains into boiling water and then the Fire.

outline.heading: Exulting in the land without right
outline.gist: Their time was wasted and they did not take the matter seriously, so we must call people to Allah to spare them this end.

outline.heading: Have they not travelled in the land?
outline.gist: We should fear for others as we fear for ourselves; earlier nations' faith did not help them once they saw the punishment, which is Allah's way with His servants.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.label: Dawah, outreach and representing Islam
themes.note: Ghafir teaches calling even those who dispute, never judging anyone beyond hope, and the believing man's method of argument.

themes.label: Tawakkul: reliance on Allah
themes.note: Musa and the believing man both entrust their affair to Allah after doing their part; the caller works and leaves results to Him.

themes.label: Hope, fear and the balance between them
themes.note: Forgiver of sin and severe in punishment must be taught together; tilting either way distorts the deen.

themes.label: Dua and invocation
themes.note: Allah commands us to call on Him in this life, contrasted with the unanswered dua of the people of the Fire.

themes.label: Humility vs vanity and arrogance
themes.note: Arrogance is claiming a status Allah did not give, a height never reached, ending in regret.

themes.label: Reform (islah)
themes.note: Tyrants like Pharaoh accuse reformers of being the corrupters.

themes.label: The Hereafter: resurrection, judgment, paradise, hellfire
themes.note: Scenes of the Day and the Fire show why people must be warned while there is time.

maxims: Call on Allah now, or call in vain later
Do your part and leave the outcome to Allah

stories.point: Tyrants accuse reformers of corruption; Musa answers by seeking refuge in Allah.

stories.who: The believing man of Pharaoh's family
stories.point: Faith that cannot stay hidden, a model of argument by logic, admonition, emotion and history, ending in tafwid.

stories.who: The weak and the arrogant in the Fire
stories.point: Followers cannot be saved by those they followed, and dua there is not answered.

takeaways: Keep calling people to Allah, including those who argue, and never declare anyone lost
Teach Allah's forgiveness and His punishment together, without tipping the balance
Do your part in dawah and entrust the outcome to Allah
Make dua a constant relationship with Allah in this life
Study the believing man's arguments in Ghafir as a model of dawah

36:3.en: Lo! thou art of those sent

36:5.en: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful

36:6.ar: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمࣰ ا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
36:6.en: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless

36:7.ar: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
36:7.en: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not

36:8.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
36:8.en: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked

36:9.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
36:9.en: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not

36:10.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
36:10.en: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not

36:11.ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةࣲ وَأَجۡرࣲ كَرِيمٍ
36:11.en: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward

36:12.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
36:12.en: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register)

36:13.ar: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:13.en: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them

36:14.ar: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثࣲ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
36:14.en: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you

36:15.ar: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
36:15.en: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie

36:16.ar: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:16.en: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you

36:17.en: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message)

36:18.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
36:18.en: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands

36:19.ar: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
36:19.en: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk

36:20.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلࣱ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
36:20.en: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent

36:21.ar: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
36:21.en: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided

36:22.ar: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
36:22.en: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back

36:23.ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرࣲّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
36:23.en: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save

36:24.ar: إِنِّيٓ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
36:24.en: Then truly I should be in error manifest

36:25.en: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me

36:26.ar: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
36:26.en: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

36:27.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
36:27.en: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones

36:28.ar: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندࣲ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
36:28.en: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send

36:29.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
36:29.en: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct

36:30.ar: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
36:30.en: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

36:31.ar: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
36:31.en: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them

36:32.ar: وَإِن كُلࣱّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
36:32.en: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us

36:33.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبࣰّ ا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
36:33.en: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof

36:34.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣲ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
36:34.en: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein

36:35.ar: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
36:35.en: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks

36:36.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
36:36.en: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not

36:37.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
36:37.en: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness

36:38.ar: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرࣲّ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
36:38.en: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise

36:39.ar: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
36:39.en: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf

36:40.ar: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلࣱّ فِي فَلَكࣲ يَسۡبَحُونَ
36:40.en: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit

36:41.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
36:41.en: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship

36:42.ar: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
36:42.en: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride

36:43.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
36:43.en: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved

36:44.ar: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
36:44.en: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while

36:45.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
36:45.en: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless)

36:46.ar: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةࣲ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
36:46.en: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it

36:47.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
36:47.en: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest

36:48.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
36:48.en: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful

36:49.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
36:49.en: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing

36:50.ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةࣰ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
36:50.en: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk

36:51.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
36:51.en: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord

36:52.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:52.en: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth

36:53.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
36:53.en: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us

36:54.ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
36:54.en: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do

36:55.ar: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلࣲ فَٰكِهُونَ
36:55.en: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed

36:56.ar: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
36:56.en: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining

36:57.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
36:57.en: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask

36:58.ar: سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبࣲّ رَّحِيمࣲ‏
36:58.en: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace

36:59.en: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day

36:60.ar: ۞أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:60.en: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe

36:61.en: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path

36:70.ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيࣰّ ا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
36:70.en: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers

36:71.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمࣰ ا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
36:71.en: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners

36:72.ar: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
36:72.en: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food

36:73.ar: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
36:73.en: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks

36:74.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
36:74.en: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped

36:75.ar: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
36:75.en: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms

36:80.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارࣰ ا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
36:80.en: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it

36:81.ar: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
36:81.en: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator

36:82.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
36:82.en: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is

36:83.ar: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
36:83.en: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back

No0lBfWvD_s.speaker_note: the sheikh's Surah Summaries series; single voice throughout
No0lBfWvD_s.title: Surat Ya-Sin Summary
No0lBfWvD_s.one_line: Ya-Sin, often linked with death, is really about life: submission to Allah and carrying His message make a life truly lived.
No0lBfWvD_s.summary: He places Ya-Sin in a cluster of surahs about submitting one's will to Allah's will, each from a different angle. Ya-Sin is widely recited for the dead, a practice he notes has weak support but need not be fought; he suggests the real link is the contrast between death and life. The surah's message is that obeying Allah and carrying His message is what makes a person truly alive, while many who breathe are not really living and some who die live on. The enemy of life is heedlessness: being absorbed in trivial matters, pictured as chains and barriers people place on themselves so they cannot see the truth. The believer who ran from the edge of the city to support three messengers lived briefly but fully, and even after being killed wished his people knew of his forgiveness. Dead land brought to life and made to feed others is a picture of what a believer's life can be. Refusing to give because Allah could have fed the poor is a living death, since giving is the sweetest thing in life. He insists paradise is anything but boring: its people are busy, learning and growing closer to Allah without end. The warning is for those who are alive, and those who seek help from lifeless idols share their deadness.

outline.heading: Opening
A cluster of surahs on submitting to Allah's will
outline.gist: Earlier surahs looked at submission when commands are hard, as a community and civilization, and through right understanding that leads to sound decisions.

outline.heading: Why Ya-Sin is tied to death: a surah about real life
outline.gist: Reciting it for the dead is widespread though weakly supported; the deeper link is that obeying Allah and carrying His message is what makes one truly alive.

outline.heading: Ya-Sin and the warning to a heedless people
outline.gist: Three readings of the opening letters; the Prophet is sent to warn people whose forefathers were not warned and who live in negligence.

outline.heading: Heedlessness kills life: chains and barriers
outline.gist: Preoccupation with trivia is the enemy of life; the chains and barriers are moral ones people build so they need not see the truth.

outline.heading: Allah revives the dead and records their traces
outline.gist: Allah writes down deeds and their aftermath; those who do nothing leave no legacy to record.

outline.heading: The believer of Ya-Sin
outline.gist: The Quran leaves him unnamed and simply calls him a believing man.

outline.heading: Three messengers rejected; a man comes running
outline.gist: A town rejects three messengers bringing one message; a man from its outskirts runs to urge his people to follow those who ask no reward.

outline.heading: Killed, then 'if only my people knew'
outline.gist: The surah skips his killing because it is about a life lived; entering paradise he wishes his people knew of his forgiveness.

outline.heading: A life worth living outlasts death
outline.gist: Everyone dies, but committing to what you believe in makes life continue through legacy and with Allah.

outline.heading: Alas for the servants
outline.gist: The pity is people wasting limited lives on what is not worth living for.

outline.heading: Dead land revived: a life that gives life
outline.gist: As Allah revives dead earth and makes it feed others, He revives hearts that submit so their lives give life to others.

outline.heading: Refusing to give: a living death
outline.gist: Saying Allah could have fed the poor himself, while enjoying life's pleasures, is a life not worth living.

outline.heading: One blast while chatting about trivia
outline.gist: They ask when the reckoning comes while absorbed in useless talk; on that Day everyone is treated fairly.

outline.heading: Nothing sweeter than giving
outline.gist: The purest joy a soul tastes is giving when given the chance; refusing it misunderstands life.

outline.heading: Paradise is not boring
outline.gist: Its people are busy with joy, exploring Allah's dominion and growing in knowledge and closeness without limit, which is what being alive means.

outline.heading: To warn those who are alive
outline.gist: The warning is for those who understand the value of life.

outline.heading: Seeking life from what is dead
outline.gist: Allah provides livestock and every need, yet they seek help from lifeless idols.

outline.heading: The green tree becomes fire; 'Be, and it is'
outline.gist: What lives will die in the cycle Allah made; He holds the dominion of everything and all return to Him.

outline.heading: Outro

97:1.en: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination

97:2.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is

97:3.ar: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرࣲ‏
97:3.en: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months

97:4.ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرࣲ‏
97:4.en: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees

97:5.en: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn

98:1.ar: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
98:1.en: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them

98:2.ar: رَسُولࣱ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفࣰ ا مُّطَهَّرَةࣰ‏
98:2.en: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

98:4.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
98:4.en: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them

98:5.ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
98:5.en: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion

98:6.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
98:6.en: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings

98:7.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
98:7.en: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings

98:8.ar: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدࣰ اۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
98:8.en: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord

_XjjTn-yrsY.speaker: adnan
_XjjTn-yrsY.speaker_note: his surah-summary series in a Ramadan night session at the masjid
_XjjTn-yrsY.title: Surah Summaries: Al-Qadr and Al-Bayyina
_XjjTn-yrsY.one_line: Al-Qadr teaches that quality outweighs quantity, so find your own night of status; al-Bayyina reduces the deen to tawhid, worship, giving and unity.
_XjjTn-yrsY.summary: He notes that al-Qadr was revealed in Makkah a decade before fasting Ramadan was prescribed, so its first audience could not have read it as being about the annual night. Its concept is that quality matters more than quantity: one night is better than a thousand months, just as one stance, word or deed can make a person remembered for centuries while a long life of mediocrity is forgotten. He urges everyone to look for their own night of status, the deed they were destined for; the angels and peace in the surah describe the inner peace of a person fulfilling their purpose, which is why the Prophet was always calm, and the Prophet's own night of destiny was the first revelation. Al-Bayyina, he says, exists to simplify. Its clarification has two parts. What not to do: divide. Earlier communities split after clarity came, and Muslims who agree on nearly everything magnify a handful of obscure differences, which he saw growing up between scholars in two regions. What to do: sincere tawhid, prayer as the symbol of personal worship, and zakat as the symbol of worship that benefits others. Those who hold to this are the best of creation, and Allah being pleased with them is the greatest reward.

outline.heading: Opening
Al-Qadr revealed before Ramadan was prescribed
outline.gist: The surah came about ten years before fasting was made central, so it first taught a concept rather than describing the annual night.

outline.heading: The night of the first revelation; meanings of qadr
outline.gist: Destiny, status and power are all valid renderings.

outline.heading: Quality is more important than quantity
outline.gist: Few people bring both in any field; when you cannot, quality is what counts.

outline.heading: A long forgettable life versus one moment remembered
outline.gist: A life of eighty years can leave nothing, while a single stance or deed is carried to the end of time.

outline.heading: Look for your own night of status
outline.gist: One outstanding action can outweigh a lifetime of mediocrity; seek the legacy you will be remembered by.

outline.heading: No one will remember the details of your life
outline.gist: Schools, weddings and quarrels are forgotten; the one meaningful deed is what lasts.

outline.heading: Angels and peace: the calm of fulfilling your purpose
outline.gist: We are only truly at peace when doing what we were created to do.

outline.heading: Why the Prophet was always calm
outline.gist: He was always serving his higher purpose; people without one live with something missing.

outline.heading: The Prophet's night of destiny
outline.gist: His whole life prepared for the first revelation, the night that changed everything.

outline.heading: Al-Bayyina: Makki or Madani, and its paradox
outline.gist: Hard to memorize, yet its purpose is to simplify.

outline.heading: Simplifying what the deen requires
outline.gist: The load of commands can confuse and tire; reduce it to the real basics.

outline.heading: The clear proof: a messenger reciting purified pages
outline.gist: Allah keeps clarifying what people distort; suhuf here means chapters of valuable information.

outline.heading: What not to do: divide
outline.gist: Object or criticize as you like, but division is the cardinal sin against the ummah.

outline.heading: We agree on almost everything, then magnify the rest
outline.gist: Out of a thousand questions we differ on a handful and fight over them for centuries, even over issues most Muslims cannot follow.

outline.heading: Growing up between two scholarly worlds
outline.gist: Teachers in two regions each emphasized their points of difference, on which hundreds of theses were written.

outline.heading: No excuse for our division
outline.gist: We have vast common ground yet prefer labelling and excluding one another, as earlier communities did.

outline.heading: First command: sincere monotheism
outline.gist: Worship Allah alone with full sincerity; no one disagrees on this.

outline.heading: Second command: prayer as the symbol of personal worship
outline.gist: Acts between you and Allah that do not directly benefit others.

outline.heading: Third command: zakat as the symbol of worship that helps others
outline.gist: All acts that directly benefit someone else.

outline.heading: Stay one ummah and fear being a cause of division
outline.gist: Sit together and find a way; let the thought of having caused division keep you up at night.

outline.heading: Organizations that cannot work together
outline.gist: Letting go of ego to collaborate; recap of the three rules.

outline.heading: What is confusing about this?
outline.gist: Tawhid, your relationship with Allah, helping others and not dividing; coming to the masjid and helping someone covers all three.

outline.heading: Worst and best of creation; gardens of Eden
outline.gist: Those who distort this simple clarification versus those who believe and act.

outline.heading: Allah pleased with them: the greatest reward
outline.gist: Reverence for Allah makes you think twice before dividing, neglecting prayer or failing to help.

outline.heading: Outro
